summary: BTC order page: the order book and trades panels now show a feed status badge with the last-updated time (Live while updating, Stale when the order book stops updating at the default aggregation); before shots from base 79374ac use the same recipe nodes.

before_after_pairs.label: AC1 order book still renders price levels (regression guard)
AC2 order book: no status vs '● Live · Updated <time>' in the filters row
AC3 trades: no status vs '● Live · Updated <time>' above the list
AC4 order book at default aggregation: frozen book with no status vs '● Stale · Updated <time>' with levels still shown

videos.note: BLOCKED: --record-video is not implemented for the terminal adapter. Screenshots come from the terminal adapter's ui.screenshot (headless Chrome viewport capture); the adapter hides the recipe HUD during capture by design, so the HUD is not visible even with --hud show.
